implementation: GemXpresso R4 E36/E72 PK Cryptographic Library
description: This implementation is dedicated to provide the crypto algorithm on the GemXpresso R4 E36/E72 PK Java card product through the Java Card 2.2.1 API. It provides Random Number generation, 3DES, AES, SHA-1 and RSA up to 2048 bits key length as well as RSA On Board Key generation up to 2048 bits long.
